name: @matdata/schema-explorer
description: Visual explorer for XML Schema (XSD) and, later, JSON Schema: UML-like diagrams, content-model trees and readable pages. Web app and <schema-explorer> web component.
author: Mathias Vanden Auweele <mathias@matdata.eu>

scripts.build: npm run wasm && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.build:lib: npm run wasm && vite build --config vite.lib.config.ts && tsc -p tsconfig.lib.json
